fields.label: Story intro
fields.sample:
It started with a conversation, turned into a friendship, grew into
an adventure and somehow, here we are.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample:
Your presence, your kindness,
your love and your support
made this weekend truly unforgettable.
We feel so lucky to have you
in our lives and at the beginning
of this new chapter.

fields.label: Cover photo
fields.help: A vertical, high-resolution photo of the couple works best.

elements.text:
A SPECIAL DAY
A BRIGHTER
TOMORROW

elements.name: Slogan
elements.text: A LOVE STORY WORTH THE HEADLINES

elements.name: Kapak notu
elements.text:
From a chance meeting
to forever — our biggest
adventure begins here.

elements.name: Kapak alıntısı
elements.text:
Different paths.
Same destination.
A love story
that feels like home.

elements.name: Baskı içeriği
elements.text:
THE PEOPLE
THE PLACES
THE MOMENTS
THE FOREVER

elements.name: Künye sağ
elements.text:
PEOPLE
PLACES
AND A LOVE
THAT GREW

elements.name: Not 1
elements.text:
A chance meeting,
a different kind of
connection.

elements.name: Not 2
elements.text:
New cities,
braver plans,
a deeper “us.”

elements.name: Alıntı
elements.text:
“YOU
MAKE
ORDINARY
DAYS FEEL
EXTRA-
ORDINARY.”

elements.name: Not 3
elements.text:
More road trips,
more laughter,
more reasons
to choose each other.

elements.name: Not 4
elements.text:
A home, a dog,
a future we can’t
wait to build.

elements.name: Not 5
elements.text:
Still us,
Just a bigger
adventure.

elements.name: Kapanış
elements.text:
SAME HEARTS.
NEW CHAPTERS.
A BEAUTIFULLY
WRITTEN FOREVER.

elements.name: Spot
elements.text: GOOD PEOPLE. BRIGHT MOMENTS. A STORY WE’LL ALWAYS REMEMBER.

elements.name: Not 1
elements.text:
LAUGHTER
LOOKS GOOD
ON THIS
CROWD.

elements.name: Not 2
elements.text:
GOOD FOOD.
GREAT COMPANY.
UNFORGETTABLE NIGHTS.

elements.name: Not 3
elements.text:
TO LOVE,
TO FRIENDS,
TO ALL THE
CHAPTERS AHEAD.

elements.name: El yazısı not 2
elements.text:
Moments
Like These
Make Life
Extra Ordinary

elements.name: Not 4
elements.text:
REAL
PEOPLE.
REAL
EMOTIONS.
OUR
KIND OF
PERFECT.

elements.name: Not 5
elements.text:
BECAUSE THESE
FRIENDS BECAME FAMILY,
AND THE BEST KIND OF
ENERGY FILLED THE WEEKEND.

elements.name: Not 6
elements.text:
A WEEKEND
WE’LL KEEP
IN OUR HEARTS
FOREVER.

elements.name: Alt not 2
elements.text: THANK YOU FOR WALKING THIS ONE WITH US.

elements.name: Alt not 3
elements.text: THE BEST IS YET TO COME.
